asset.name: Primary Database
asset.description: Transactional database for accounts, sessions and orders.

asset.name: External Gateway
asset.description: Edge load balancer / reverse proxy terminating TLS for public traffic.

asset.name: Customer Portal
asset.description: Public web front end used by customers.

asset.name: Monitoring Service
asset.description: Metrics, alerting and dashboards for operations staff.

asset.name: Telemetry Ingestion Gateway
asset.description: Receives metrics and log streams for monitoring.

asset.name: Log Shipping Agent
asset.description: Collects and forwards application and audit logs to telemetry ingestion.

asset.name: Message Queue
asset.description: Durable event bus for asynchronous jobs (orders, receipts, notifications).

asset.name: Application API
asset.description: Core business API serving the portal and partner integrations.

asset.name: Notification Service
asset.description: Sends e-mail and push notifications from queued events.

asset.name: Analytics Service
asset.description: Business reporting from event streams and database replicas.

asset.name: Internal Admin Portal
asset.description: Staff back-office for account and order administration (not internet-facing).

dependency.rationale: All public traffic reaches the portal through the gateway.
Portal pages are rendered from API data.
Every API call validates a session token.
API reads and writes transactional records.
Document upload/download features fail; core flows continue.
Metrics export is best-effort.
User credentials and sessions are stored in the primary database.
Monitoring has no data without ingestion.
Shipper buffers logs locally while ingestion is down.
Restores read only from the independent offsite vault.
Job status reporting is best-effort.
Checkout fails without payments; browsing and accounts continue.
Async jobs are delayed; synchronous requests continue.
Every payment is tied to an authenticated session.
Orders and ledgers live in the primary database.
Receipts are published asynchronously.
Notifications are driven entirely by queued events.
Staff sign in through the authentication service.
Back-office screens call the application API.
Analytics consumes the event stream.
Historical reports read a replica; live dashboards continue.

incident.title: Simulated authentication compromise — Authentication Service
incident.description: SIMULATION: synthetic credential-stuffing and session-token abuse against the Authentication Service. Services that trust its tokens are flagged as potentially exposed; they are not declared compromised.

incident.title: Simulated outage — Primary (user) Database unavailable
incident.description: SIMULATION: the primary user database stops responding. Services that require it become unavailable; services with non-critical dependencies degrade.

incident.title: Simulated traffic surge — External Gateway
incident.description: SIMULATION: abnormal synthetic request volume against the External Gateway. Latency and error rates rise and the gateway saturates if not mitigated. No real traffic is generated.

incidentEvidence.title: Credential-stuffing burst
incidentEvidence.detail: 2106 failed sign-ins from 36 source addresses within 4 minutes against 312 distinct accounts.

incidentEvidence.title: Impossible travel on administrator account
incidentEvidence.detail: Account adm.jrivera (synthetic) authenticated from Dallas, US and Frankfurt, DE eleven minutes apart.

incidentEvidence.title: MFA push fatigue
incidentEvidence.detail: 21 MFA push prompts sent to the same administrator within 6 minutes; one was approved.

incidentEvidence.title: Session tokens minted with elevated scope
incidentEvidence.detail: Three refresh tokens with admin:* scope issued outside the change window.

incidentEvidence.title: Containment action executed (simulated)
incidentEvidence.detail: Revoke sessions & rotate signing keys on Authentication Service by Ben (Analyst). No real systems were changed.

incidentEvidence.title: Primary heartbeat lost
incidentEvidence.detail: No heartbeat from the primary node for 45 s; health probe returned TCP reset.

incidentEvidence.title: Connection pool exhausted
incidentEvidence.detail: Application connection pools report 0 of 200 connections available; 1,180 requests queued.

incidentEvidence.title: Replication stalled
incidentEvidence.detail: Standby replica stopped applying WAL; replication lag 255 s and climbing.

incidentEvidence.title: Request rate anomaly
incidentEvidence.detail: Inbound request rate 8.0× the 7-day baseline, concentrated on /api/search and /login.

incidentEvidence.title: Concentrated source networks
incidentEvidence.detail: 82% of new connections originate from three autonomous systems; sample 203.0.113.10.

incidentEvidence.title: Sustained surge
incidentEvidence.detail: External Gateway: request rate remains 9.6× baseline.
